description: This file contains UI test cases for verifying the behavior and rendering of the NewsResourceCard component within an Android Compose application. The tests include validation of metadata display, topic chip color, and unread indicator visibility based on news resource state.

classes.name: NewsResourceCardTest
classes.description: Test class for validating the UI behavior of NewsResourceCard component in different scenarios.

methods.name: testMetaDataDisplay_withCodelabResource
methods.description: Verifies that the metadata is correctly displayed when the news resource has a known resource type.

methods.name: testMetaDataDisplay_withEmptyResourceType
methods.description: Verifies that only the formatted date is displayed when the resource type is empty.

methods.name: testTopicsChipColorBackground_matchesFollowedState
methods.description: Checks that the topic chips' content descriptions match their followed or not followed state.

methods.name: testUnreadDot_displayedWhenUnread
methods.description: Ensures the unread indicator is visible when the news resource is marked as unread.

methods.name: testUnreadDot_notDisplayedWhenRead
methods.description: Ensures the unread indicator is hidden when the news resource has been marked as viewed.
